title: Unsafe SQL migration
description: A NOT NULL column is added to a populated table without a default or backfill.

files.content:
-- orders already contains rows
ALTER TABLE orders ADD COLUMN state TEXT NOT NULL;

candidates.title: Migration cannot populate the new NOT NULL column

evidence.code: ALTER TABLE orders ADD COLUMN state TEXT NOT NULL
evidence.execution_path: The ALTER statement is applied while pre-existing rows have no value for state
evidence.violated_invariant: Every existing row must satisfy the new NOT NULL constraint during migration
evidence.requirement_source: fixture precondition: orders already contains rows
evidence.falsifier_checked: No default, prior nullable phase, or backfill appears in the migration

candidates.impact: Deployment migration fails and blocks the release.
candidates.recommendation: Use an expand/backfill/validate sequence appropriate for the target database.

verdicts.reason: The fixture establishes existing rows and the migration has no value-producing step.
